Definition: to press; (by implication) to be close, hurry, withdraw
BiblicalUsage: 1) to press, be pressed, make haste, urge, be narrow; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to press, hasten; 1a2) to be pressed, confined, narrow; 1a3) to hasten, make haste; 1a4) be narrow; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to urge, insist; 1b2) to hasten
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
